_comment: Rows Massgate adds to the Icarus data tables. Applied by tools/build.py on top of the base tables. Row names are prefixed Massgate_ so they never collide with the game or other mods. Two craftable items: Massgate_Anchor (base end) and Massgate_Resonator (field end), both built on the game's small metal crate actor so they get the standard storage panel (hold F) as an Exotics buffer; the Lua swaps their meshes. Channels are the three QCD colour charges (Red, Green, Blue); the channel is a setting on the placed gate (alt-press 'Tune channel'), stored by the Lua. Tables marked per_channel are expanded once per channel with {CH} replaced and "{CH_COLOR}" replaced by the channel's colour object. Rows named Massgate_<Kind>_<CH> and Massgate_Gate are legacy items from earlier builds, kept without recipes so placed gates keep loading.

add.Name: Item_Massgate_Anchor
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Anchor-Description", "The base end of a Massgate pair. A heavy lattice of stabilised exotic matter that bends space toward itself and pulls whatever stands in a tuned Resonator's field back to this pad. Tune it to one of the three colour charges; an anchor triplet of all three colours is colour-neutral, which is why anchors can stand side by side. Hold to open the lattice and load it with Exotics: every outbound transit burns some to re-stabilise the lattice. Inbound transits are carried by the anchor's own mass. Needs heavy power. Panel layout (hold interact): slots 1-4 Exotics, slot 5 module, slot 6 Tuning Crystal.")
add.FlavorText: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Anchor-FlavorText", "Three colours. No fourth. Confinement is not a limit of the machine but of the universe. UDA Field Manual, addendum 7, classified.")

add.Name: Item_Massgate_Resonator
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Resonator-Description", "The field end of a Massgate pair. A sliver of exotic lattice carrying a single colour charge, just enough to phase-lock to the Anchor of the same colour. Light, modest on power, and unshielded: any other lattice within 500 m, Anchor or Resonator, pulls it off frequency and it refuses to tune. Place it far from everything and give it its own small power supply. Panel layout (hold interact): slots 1-4 Exotics, slot 5 module, slot 6 Tuning Crystal.")
add.FlavorText: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Resonator-FlavorText", "A tuning fork does not sing on its own. It waits for the bell.")

add.Name: Item_Massgate_Coupler
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Coupler-Description", "Slots into the module bay of an Anchor Lattice (the fifth slot of its panel). A tuned pair already shares a phase; the coupler lets the anchor push energy along the colour channel, so its Resonator needs no power supply of its own. Pushing power as well as a prospector costs extra Exotics per outbound transit.")
add.FlavorText: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Coupler-FlavorText", "Strike the bell hard enough and the fork sings on its own.")

tables._comment: Legacy per-channel items from earlier builds. No recipes.

add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Anchor_{CH}-Description", "An early Anchor from before channels could be tuned. Pick it up and place a current Anchor Lattice instead.")

add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Resonator_{CH}-Description", "An early Resonator from before channels could be tuned. Pick it up and place a current Resonator instead.")

tables._comment: Legacy v0.1 row. Lua treats it as an Anchor.

add.Name: Item_Massgate_Gate
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Gate-Description", "An early prototype lattice. Behaves as an Anchor. Pick it up and place a current Anchor Lattice instead.")

tables._comment: Map + compass icons per kind and channel; the Lua points each gate's map-icon component at Massgate_<Kind>_<Channel>.
The lattice panel: slots 0-3 Exotics only (Any_Meta), slot 4 module (T4 communicator-upgrade tag), slot 5 tuning crystal (T3 communicator-upgrade tag). Our module and crystal items carry those tags.
Icon rows for gates without a tuning crystal.
The deployed container actor renders the item's Meshable mesh, so this is what a placed gate looks like.
Tuning crystals: slot one into a gate's panel to set its colour charge.

add.Name: Item_Massgate_Crystal_{CH}
add.Description: NSLOCTEXT("D_Itemable", "Item_Massgate_Crystal_{CH}-Description", "A shard of exotic lattice carrying the {CH} colour charge. Slot it into the tuning slot of a Massgate Anchor or Resonator (the last slot of its panel) and the lattice takes on that colour. Two lattices of the same colour tune to one another; there are three colours and no fourth.")
